subject: The 3-day mistake 90% of users make
preview_text: I discovered something about healing speed that changes everything. Most people skip this one thing.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. When I built Fresh Start, I made a huge assumption. I thought people would naturally use the app every day. But I was wrong. And that mistake is costing people weeks of unnecessary heartache.

Here's the truth I discovered from our 600+ users: the ones who heal 40% faster aren't smarter or stronger. They just do one simple thing for 3 days straight. It's not about marathon sessions. It's about tiny, consistent wins that build momentum. When you commit to just 5 minutes a day for 3 days, something shifts. The obsessive thoughts lose their grip. The 3AM spirals get shorter. You start believing 'I can actually do this.'

That's why I built the 3-Day Momentum Challenge right into the app. It's not another feature to ignore. It's your secret hack to break the cycle of one-day-on, three-days-off that keeps you stuck. The challenge uses your mood tracker, gives you targeted journal prompts, and unlocks custom coping strategies based on your specific breakup type. It's the shortcut our fastest-healing users found by accident.

Your challenge starts today. Open the app, tap 'Challenges' on the home screen, and commit to 3 days. Don't overthink it. Just show up for 5 minutes. I'll be checking in tomorrow to see how day one went. P.S. The users who complete this challenge are 3x more likely to hit a 30-day no-contact streak. That's when the real magic happens.
